display_title: FuseNet Support of Master Students going on an internship abroad – EUROfusion
call_title: FuseNet Support of Master Students going on an internship abroad
executive_summary: Cascade call issued within EUROfusion, the consortium implementing the European fusion research roadmap (grant agreement 101052200, funded by the Euratom Research and Training Programme), and run by FuseNet, the European Fusion Education Network. It gives individual MSc students in a fusion-relevant field, registered at a university in a EUROfusion member state where the university or the host is a FuseNet member, a fixed travel allowance and living support for an internship of 6 weeks to 6 months at a fusion research centre or university in another country; all support combined may not exceed EUR 1,000 per month. Total funding EUR 100,000. It runs on a rolling, first-come first-served basis until the budget is used, with applications at least two weeks before the internship starts and a final deadline of 31 December 2026; decisions follow within two weeks.
status_rationale: The FuseNet internship Terms and Conditions 2026 (Requirements and Application procedure) and the Funding & Tenders Portal call page (Task description) fund travel and living costs of individual Master students doing fusion research internships abroad. It does not touch TenneT's field: no project file is close, and mobility grants for fusion physics students do not build the transmission, grid-operation or offshore workforce TenneT needs. It is on a rolling basis while the budget lasts; both project dates are null because the call ties the internship to each application and states only its duration.
